Arrange the following stages of human subsistence in historical chronological sequence:

(A) Plantation and Commercial Grain Agriculture

Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

- Garrison/Cantonment towns: Jalandhar, Ambala, Mhow, Babina (IV).
Matching: (A)-(I), (B)-(II), (C)-(III), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (D) is the correct match.
Hence, option (B) is the correct match.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: High-technology manufacturing complexes typically feature planned, spacious, campus-style developments with manicured landscaping.
Statement II: High-technology industries deliberately locate in narrow, soot-covered slums alongside open-hearth blast furnaces.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains an error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Statement I is correct: technopolies and high-tech parks feature modern campus layouts with green lawns and clean buildings. Statement II is false: high-tech explicitly rejects the dirty environments of traditional smoke-stack heavy industry.
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.
